Axiom:
State-mutating Vitest helpers MUST be paired with their teardown: - `vi.useFakeTimers()` ↔ `vi.useRealTimers()` (use `vi.setSystemTime(date)` for clock). - `vi.stubEnv(...)` ↔ `vi.unstubAllEnvs()` (or `unstubEnvs: true`). - `vi.stubGlobal(...)` ↔ `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` (or `unstubGlobals: true`).
Forbidden: enabling any of these inside a single case without restoring — leaks into every later case in the same file. Classic source of order-dependent flicker that looks random.
